title: **A count over a list of years reads as one
notes: grouped number.** A cell showing "1" over "2026" (two block lines) has
innerText "1\n2026", which `AMOUNT_TEXT` takes as 12026, so a correct
"Años" column was flagged `sort-broken`. Worked around in the consumer ("1
año"); the probe could read block lines separately.
result: Detect separate numeric lines before amount parsing so count/year cells retain normalized textual keys instead of concatenating digits. Single amounts with wrapped units, grouped horizontal whitespace and USD prefixes retain numeric behavior. The separate tied-count primary-sort task remains pending; no npm release or application deployment occurred.
